summary: Frontend-only retest after mobile responsive + Admin CMS coverage fixes. All 10 review-request items verified end-to-end on mobile (375x844) and desktop (1920x1080). Hero buttons clickable on mobile and quote wizard opens; Projects cards show title/category/description without hover; Contact cards tappable; /admin/site has new Kontakt + Footer tabs and contactEmail change persists to homepage; /admin/invoice-templates has new pro design (stats, search, gradient header) and -> Rechnung navigation pre-fills items from template via location.state.templateId; Neue Vorlage modal works with Aus Katalog dropdown.

issues: Page has ~2px horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=377 vs clientWidth=375). Likely caused by a section with negative margin or fixed-width child. Cosmetic only - no scrollbar visible to users but worth fixing to be 100% mobile-clean.
Contact cards appear to extend slightly past the right viewport edge in screenshot (likely the cause of the 2px overflow). Verify the cards' container max-width / padding on small screens.

test_results_per_review_item.mobile_hero_buttons_visible_clickable: PASS - both hero-contact-btn (y=307) and hero-quote-btn (y=376) visible; element-from-point at center is the button content (SPAN inside button), not the partner bar. Clicking hero-quote-btn opens the 4-step Angebot wizard modal correctly.
test_results_per_review_item.mobile_hero_badge_hidden: PASS - '12 MONATE' text not present in DOM on mobile.
test_results_per_review_item.mobile_no_horizontal_overflow: MINOR - 2px overflow (377 vs 375) detected; reported as design issue.
test_results_per_review_item.mobile_projects_text_always_visible: PASS - 6 project cards each show title (Basel Akademie, Genfer Tour Operator, ...), category (BILDUNGSPLATTFORM, REISE-PLATTFORM, ...) and description without hover. Each card has data-testid='project-<id>'.
test_results_per_review_item.mobile_contact_cards_tappable: PASS - 4 cards visible with correct hrefs: contact-email-card -> mailto:info@redwork.ch, contact-phone-card -> tel:+41441234567, contact-whatsapp-card -> https://wa.me/41791234567, contact-address-card -> maps.google.com.
test_results_per_review_item.admin_site_has_kontakt_footer_tabs: PASS - 10 tabs found including '📞 Kontakt' and 'Footer'.
test_results_per_review_item.admin_kontakt_tab_fields: PASS - inputs present with data-testids: contact-title-input, contact-phone-input, contact-email-input, contact-whatsapp-input, contact-address-input, plus telefon-zeiten, email-hinweis, karten-iframe url. (NOTE: testids use kebab-case e.g. contact-email-input, not camelCase contactEmail.)
test_results_per_review_item.admin_contact_email_persists_to_homepage: PASS - changed contactEmail to test-contact@redwork.ch via admin Speichern, reloaded /, scrolled to #kontakt; contact-email-card showed test-contact@redwork.ch with mailto link. Reverted to info@redwork.ch successfully.
test_results_per_review_item.invoice_templates_pro_design: PASS - gradient header with Rechnungs-Vorlagen title, 4 stats cards (Vorlagen=1, Positionen ges.=2, Ø Wert (CHF)=2028, Katalog-Produkte=21), search input 'Vorlagen durchsuchen...', template card with → Rechnung (green) and → Offerte (blue) buttons plus edit/duplicate/delete icons.
test_results_per_review_item.neue_vorlage_modal: PASS - opens 'Neue Vorlage erstellen' modal with Name, Beschreibung, '▸ Erweitert: Standard-Titel & Notizen' expander, '📦 Aus Katalog +' dropdown listing 21 catalog products (TEST_Product, Landing-Page, Unternehmens-Website, ...), Leere/Abbrechen/Speichern buttons.
test_results_per_review_item.template_to_invoice_prefill: PASS - clicking '→ Rechnung' on Webdesign Standard template navigates to /admin/invoices/new and pre-fills items: row1 Landing Page qty=1 price=1800, row2 Hosting 1 Jahr qty=1 price=228; summary shows Zwischensumme CHF 2028.00, MwSt 8.1% CHF 164.27, Total CHF 2192.27. location.state.templateId mechanism works.

action_items: [Minor] Investigate the 2px mobile horizontal overflow (likely #kontakt cards container or a negative-margin grid). Audit with: document.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(e => {if (e.getBoundingClientRect().right > window.innerWidth) console.log(e)}) on 375px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin Kontakt tab uses kebab-case data-testids (contact-email-input) which is fine, but the review-request mentioned camelCase field names (contactEmail). Either is acceptable; just keep consistent for future automation.

Both → Rechnung and → Offerte links use plain <a href='/admin/invoices/new'> with state passed via React Router Link's state prop - the integration works. Consider adding data-testid='to-invoice-from-tpl-<id>' for more robust testing.
Sidebar nav 'Rechnungen' anchor matches the same has-text('Rechnung') selector as the template card '→ Rechnung' button - testers should always use exact text or data-testid to avoid mismatches.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of review items (10 PASS, 1 MINOR cosmetic overflow)

seed_data_creation: None new. Reverted contactEmail back to info@redwork.ch after persistence test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 frontend review items pass. Only minor 2px horizontal overflow on mobile remains. Use data-testid for hero buttons (hero-quote-btn, hero-contact-btn), contact cards (contact-email-card, contact-phone-card, contact-whatsapp-card, contact-address-card), project cards (project-<id>), admin login (admin-username/password/login-submit), and 'Neue Vorlage' button (new-tpl-btn). Site Settings Kontakt tab inputs use kebab-case: contact-{title|phone|email|whatsapp|address}-input. Sidebar 'Rechnungen' link conflicts with text-based selectors for template card '→ Rechnung' button - always use exact text matcher.
rca of the issue: N/A - all functional tests pass. The only observation is a 2px scrollWidth excess on mobile homepage, likely from the Kontakt section cards extending past their padded container; non-blocking.
